lines.zh: 我已经长成了，走路很稳。
lines.en: I have finished growing; my walk is steady.

lines.zh: 我每一步都留下灰色的印。
lines.en: Every step leaves a grey print.

lines.zh: 我比刚出现时高出一截。
lines.en: I stand a head taller than when I began.

lines.zh: 我朝有热量的方向直线走。
lines.en: I walk a straight line toward warmth.

lines.zh: 我身上的结晶排得很整齐。
lines.en: The crystals on me are neatly ordered.
I cross the grass; it stops growing.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，关节发出轻响。
lines.en: I raise an arm; a joint ticks.
I never take the long way.

lines.zh: 我一边走，身边的光就晃动。
lines.en: As I walk, the light around me sways.
My step hesitates, then continues.

lines.zh: 我朝最近的活物走过去。
lines.en: I walk toward the nearest living thing.
I stand; my body has set.

lines.zh: 我身上的灰不再往下掉。
lines.en: Grit no longer falls from me.
I am reading everything around me.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓很清楚，像刻出来的。
lines.en: My outline is clear, as if carved.

lines.zh: 我胸腔里只有石头在响。
lines.en: Only stone sounds inside my chest.
I turn my head slowly toward the sound.
The ground under me is grey.
I raise a hand and look at it.
I wait, perfectly steady.

lines.zh: 我身上的结晶亮了一下。
lines.en: My crystals flash once.

lines.zh: 我进化到最后就剩这点。
lines.en: This is all my evolution amounts to.
I am reading what is on you.
You are soft, and easy to read.
You retreat; my direction does not change.
I reach out and stop in midair.
I've read your outline once.
There are no crystals on you.
I tilt my head; a crystal rings.

lines.zh: 我掉了一块，边缘很整齐。
lines.en: A piece comes off. The edge is clean.
I crack once and stand firm again.
My outline skews for an instant.
A short click comes from me.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的碎片收回来。
lines.en: I gather the fallen fragments.
I shift back a step and hold.
My crystals dim.
The crystal draws in an inch.
I do not stop. I only slow.
I begin reading you again.
This, I can take apart.
I take the whole of it.

lines.zh: 我把它按在怀里，试着溶解。
lines.en: I press it to myself and try to dissolve it.
It does not dissolve. That surprises me.

lines.zh: 我把它吐出来，看了一遍。
lines.en: I spit it out and look again.
I take it inside.

lines.zh: 我身上多了一小块结晶。
lines.en: A new crystal forms on me.
I come toward your hand again.
I stop asking.
You hit me and step back.

lines.zh: 我像石柱一样钉在原地。
lines.en: I stand rooted like a stone pillar.

lines.zh: 我的结晶在你衣上划开一道。
lines.en: My crystal opens a line in your clothes.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，灰扬起来。
lines.en: We collide; grit lifts.
One sideways block and you're back.
I sink my weight.

lines.zh: 进化的本质，侧身让开半格。
lines.en: Evolution's essence yields half a block.
A small heap of grit remains.
Another has set its shape too.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，结晶对上了。
lines.en: We lean together, crystal to crystal.
I hand it a fragment.

lines.zh: 它接过去，嵌进自己身上。
lines.en: It takes it and fits it into place.

lines.zh: 我们一起把一片地变灰。
lines.en: Together we turn a patch of ground grey.
We sound at the same moment.
It is a little more orderly than I am.

lines.zh: 我们的轮廓对齐了一瞬。
lines.en: Our outlines align for an instant.
It leaves first. I stay.
We part and each goes on.
I lift it, steady.

lines.zh: 我看了一遍，拆开一部分。
lines.en: I look it over and take a part apart.
Too hard. I set it down.
I absorb it in.
It does not dissolve inside me.
I crush it into a lump.
I drop it by the rubble.

lines.zh: 进化到最后，就是这个样子。
lines.en: This is what the end of evolution looks like.
I have read you.
I step toward where you stand.
Every crystal on me lights.
My outline squares to you.
The ground where you stand is mine.
I am in no hurry. I will arrive.

lines.zh: 我举起结晶的手，对准你。
lines.en: I raise my crystalline hand at you.

lines.zh: 你的位置已经刻进我的结晶。
lines.en: Your position is etched into my crystal.
You have nothing to stop me.
My voice drops lower.
Your time is short.
I begin reading your movements.
The gray line has reached your feet.
I have no need to run.
This ground has already greyed.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，一直保持距离。
lines.en: I follow, keeping the distance.
You turn; I turn.
My steps are steady and never break.

lines.zh: 你砍我，只留下一道浅痕。
lines.en: You cut me; only a shallow mark.
I crowd you toward the rubble.
The wall behind you is greying.
I never shout.

lines.zh: 进化的形态，一步比一步稳。
lines.en: Evolved form: each step surer than the last.
You can hear my clicking.

lines.zh: 你退到门口，我守着那边。
lines.en: You back to the door. I hold that side.

lines.zh: 我在长，但已经没有意义。
lines.en: I am still growing, though it no longer matters.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我已经在墙边。
lines.en: When you look back, I am at the wall.

lines.zh: 我把地上的灰都吸过来。
lines.en: I draw the grey off the ground.
I am steady, and slow.
I need not hurry.
I thrust my arm out.

lines.zh: 我的结晶切开你的护甲。
lines.en: My crystal cuts your armor.
I seize your shoulder and press down.
I ram you with my whole body.

lines.zh: 这一下打空了，我撞在墙上。
lines.en: The strike misses; I hit the wall.

lines.zh: 我的边缘在你脸上留下灰。
lines.en: My edge leaves grey on your face.
You cut a piece off; I remain.
I push you into the corner.
I pull back and realign.

lines.zh: 我的声音贴着你的耳朵。
lines.en: My click is right at your ear.
I scatter fragments at your feet.
You block once and give half a step.
My whole arm comes down.

lines.zh: 结晶的手指扣住你的腕。
lines.en: Crystal fingers clamp on your wrist.
The shove sends you through the door.

lines.zh: 我停下来，看你还能站多久。
lines.en: I stop to see how long you can stand.
My body is harder than before.
My whole hand bears down on your shoulder.
You hit me; your hand comes away grey.
I raise my other hand.

lines.zh: 我已经长成了，站在这里。
lines.en: I have finished growing. I stand here.

lines.zh: 我从石堆里走出来，很稳。
lines.en: I step out of the rubble, steady.
Not one piece of my shape is missing.

lines.zh: 我第一眼就把这里读完了。
lines.en: One look and I have read this place.
I turn toward the warmth.
The soil under me greys at once.

lines.zh: 我的结晶排成整齐的列。
lines.en: My crystals stand in even rows.

lines.zh: 我试了试走路，没有问题。
lines.en: I test my walk. No problem.
I look up for the nearest light.

lines.zh: 我身上没有一点多余的灰。
lines.en: There is no loose grit on me.

lines.zh: 我记住了这片地的边界。
lines.en: I memorize the edges of this ground.

lines.zh: 火烤着我，表面一层层褪。
lines.en: Fire bakes me; layers peel away.
I crack, but do not break apart.
Water strips a layer off me.
The blast opens me in several places.
An arrow lodges between my crystals.

lines.zh: 那光让我的结构开始散。
lines.en: That light starts to loosen my structure.
I am slowly losing my shape.

lines.zh: 雷打进我体内，结晶全亮。
lines.en: Lightning enters me; my crystals flare.
Darkness draws me away whole.
